subject: MAIN-RED DIAGNOSIS: packages/types index barrel missing ranking-candidates export
body:
Tested origin/main locally with exact diagnostics.

1. FAILING TEST FILE:
   packages/types/src/__tests__/ranking-candidates.test.ts

2. ASSERTION TEXT & ERRORS:
   - vitest: AssertionError: expected 'undefined' to be 'function' on expect(typeof barrel.orderingCurrent).toBe('function') [line 21]
   - vitest: AssertionError: expected 'undefined' to be 'function' on expect(typeof barrel.extractRankingSortKey).toBe('function') [line 29]
   - tsc: error TS2339: Property 'orderingCurrent' does not exist on type 'typeof import('.../packages/types/src/index')' (plus 11 other properties)

3. TIME-DEPENDENT:
   NO. 100% deterministic missing export in barrel file packages/types/src/index.ts (needs: export * from './ranking-candidates.js';).

4. SECONDARY GUARDRAIL FAILURE:
   dependency-audit fails with '2 stale waiver(s); the vulnerability is gone, so remove the entry: next, postcss'.

All other test suites in packages/ingestion-pipeline (35 test files, 482 tests) and packages/prediction-engine (280 test files, 3141 tests) are GREEN.
